notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I'm back with a small patch just to fix a single bug!

The bug in question involved the bear trap item not triggering properly, and as a result, would let you continuously re-use the bear trap to deal damage to enemies.

This should be fixed now! 

If anyone finds anymore bugs in the game, don't hesitate to let me know! :)

-lum

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Just wanted to let everyone know that there is a patch available for PARANOIHELL now! It just addresses some bugs.

I would've liked to have gotten this patch out earlier, but my day job has been super hectic lately.

Anyways, here's what you can expect in the patch:


Light post outside of The Only is gone. This was causing enemy AI to bug out.
Fixed bug where you would have to give [spoiler]Blair some Healing Gauze [/spoiler]again, even if you had already done so.
Fixed bug where you could break the 'Survival' ending if you used a bear trap
Fixed a spelling mistake during a story sequence
Fixed bug where if you did not pick up the [spoiler]Eyeball[/spoiler], and then quit the game, it would not respawn
Changed the 'wandering locations' of a late game enemy slightly


Thanks for playing!

-lum
